sql: SELECT MIN(fish_date_t) AS min_t, MAX(fish_date_t) AS max_t, MAX(fish_date_season) AS max_season FROM trips

SELECT cls, fish_date_season, fish_date_doy, SUM(yt) AS total_yt, SUM(anglers) AS total_anglers, COUNT(*) AS n_boats
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_t > 730.875 - 10
GROUP BY cls, fish_date_season, fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls

SELECT fish_date_doy AS doy, SUM(yt) AS total_yt, SUM(anglers) AS total_anglers, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
GROUP BY doy
ORDER BY doy
SELECT index_id, avail_season, avail_doy, value FROM climate ORDER BY avail_t DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT cls, SUM(yt) AS total_yt, SUM(anglers) AS total_anglers, SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers) AS yt_per_angler, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 90 AND 260
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY yt_per_angler DESC

SELECT fish_date_doy AS doy, SUM(yt) AS total_yt, SUM(anglers) AS total_anglers
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 200 AND 365
GROUP BY doy
ORDER BY doy

SELECT cls, SUM(yt) AS total_yt, SUM(anglers) AS total_anglers, SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers) AS yt_per_angler, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 259 AND 300
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY yt_per_angler DESC

SELECT cls, SUM(yt) AS total_yt, SUM(anglers) AS total_anglers, SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers) AS yt_per_angler, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 90 AND 200
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY yt_per_angler DESC

SELECT cls, SUM(yt) AS total_yt, SUM(anglers) AS total_anglers, SUM(yt)/SUM(anglers) AS yt_per_angler, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips
WHERE cls='full_day'
GROUP BY cls
